exposure: Placenta Accreta Spectrum disorders (PAS) diagnosis and intervention
cohort: The study included 11 women who responded to a questionnaire, out of 14 cases with histopathologically confirmed PAS FIGO grade 2 and 3 treated at University Hospital Center Sao Joao.
finding: Among the 11 respondents, 4 women (36%) showed IES-R scores indicative of high risk for PTSD, with higher scores particularly in the intrusion category.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point after surgery for PAS.
